title: Deeper/broader open-source peer claim and scratch-producer route audit
mode: primary project documentation/source-page research and plan-only update
scope: Broaden the DWG/DXF/ACIS candidate screen beyond existing high-level capability claims
Separate writer, outer-format parser, inner ACIS decoder, kernel, renderer, and native-application evidence
Refine the optional scratch-generated ACIS/DXF experiment without adding routine peer work

method.kind: Read-only review of current public project documentation, repository metadata, and architecture/source descriptions
method.limitations: Mutable main/master documentation was not substituted for an immutable build or runtime result. No peer source checkout, dependency/lineage audit, generated output, ACIS parse, kernel conversion, native CAD open, or AutoCAD audit was performed. Findings refine candidate admission and do not qualify any support claim.

sources.revision: Mutable main README and repository page reviewed 2026-10-18; page reports pre-release and no listed GitHub release
sources.observed: The README describes an R2018 ASCII/Binary DXF writer, SAT/SAB ACIS authoring, known-body sample generation, ezdxf and ACadRust readback, and AutoCAD acceptance work. It marks DWG and curved surfaces beta/pre-release pending AutoCAD acceptance and states the DWG writer vendors patched ACadRust. These are route declarations; they do not establish an independently authored B-rep oracle, exact output profile for every sample command, or external acceptance.

sources.revision: Mutable main architecture and DXF/ACIS technical note reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The architecture identifies ACadSharp as the active document model and names ProGPU.Dxf as an existing renderer path. The separate DXF note describes a custom SAB token scan and edge projection, but this research did not locate or pin an exact parser artifact/profile or executable validation. The claimed route remains discovery-only and is not treated as an ACIS grammar authority or B-rep oracle.

The docs name acadrust EntityType as the input model and describe ACIS-to-kernel lifting with a per-surface fallback that marks incomplete meshes. This is a downstream kernel/display path, not an independent DWG/DXF parser or complete semantic result when fallback is used.

sources.revision: Mutable main README and detailed format table reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The broad format prose conflicts with the detailed matrix, which leaves ACIS SAT/SAB read/write unchecked; the FAQ says commercial CAD import is planned. No ACIS route was admitted.
The official preview catalog lists ACIS Import-Export as a commercial extension, corroborating that stock open-source OCCT/FreeCAD must not be presumed to include this exchange component.

The note describes partial 3DSOLID/SAB extraction without full B-rep tessellation and a best-effort wireframe or bounding-box fallback. The parser package is gated/proprietary, so it is not an open-source comparator or full semantic route.

assessment.planImpact: Tightens existing peer-admission and PAR-07/S8 composed evidence gates. obj2cad is retained as an optional exact-profile scratch producer, not a DWG writer vote or B-rep oracle. ProGPU remains discovery-only; pid-cad is ACadRust-lineage and must expose zero incomplete fallback to qualify its kernel stage; CADKernel is not admitted while its detailed table marks ACIS unsupported; stock OCCT's ACIS exchange is commercial; the proprietary partial parser is excluded from the open-source denominator.

implementationReadyChecks: Use obj2cad only at the existing optional composed checkpoint, after pinning an immutable source/artifact, toolchain, lockfile, command, output format/version, and hashes.
Inspect generated $ACADVER, entity type, group/carrier representation, and every body identity; do not infer an AC1027+ SAB or DWG AcDs route from a general README claim.
Author expected analytic parameters, units, topology, placement, bounds, volume, centroid, and tolerances independently before generation.
Report raw carrier retention, strict parser result, kernel B-rep conversion and fallback/loss counts, native open/audit, and rendering as distinct outcomes.
Keep generated samples in scratch storage; do not import peer corpus files, add peer dependencies, or run peers/native applications per implementation slice.
Continue fast local implementation validation and keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
